sprint: Restore/Discard — Six Real Bugs Behind "Restore Simply Restores a Blank Slate"
task: The third item of a new six-item governing request: 'Discard and restore options are broken when we resume the studio. Specifically restore which simply restores blank slate.' Six independent, real bugs found and fixed across the whole persist/restore chain. Bug 1: js/creatorProjectCache.js's hydrate() promise was never explicitly awaited by js/app.js's boot sequence before the app read the catalog -- fixed by adding it to bootWithPreloadGate()'s Promise.all(...) task list. Bug 2: js/gatewaySequence.js's Traveller-Privacy wipe destroyed the CURRENTLY ACTIVE session's own catalog entry -- fixed via a new clearAll(opts.preserveIds) on both creatorProjectCache.js and creatorProjectStore.js, computing the active project id via ProjectManager.getSessionStatus() before wiping. Bug A: js/projectManager.js's _writeStorage() let a small-slot quota failure abort the far-more-durable catalog write before it ever ran -- fixed by always running _syncProjectStore() first and unconditionally, wrapping only the small legacy slot's own write in its own narrow try/catch, with a new CreatorProjectStore.onPersistError() listener surfacing the one genuinely rare remaining failure mode. Bug B: getSessionStatus() never checked whether the raw session slot had gone stale relative to the durable catalog -- fixed by comparing modifiedDate vs. updatedAt on a positive id match and preferring whichever is genuinely newer. Bug C1: a glitch in showSlide()/renderList()/renderTimeline() during deserialize() could abort the entire restore even after every field was already correctly rebuilt -- fixed by wrapping that render-call trio in its own local try/catch. Bug C2: the restore-modal's onPrimary handler used to call ProjectManager.discardSession() on ANY exception from restoreSession(), permanently deleting a saved session over a possibly-recoverable rendering hiccup -- fixed so only the explicit Discard button ever removes a saved session, recovering into 'Continue a Project' on any other exception. Verified via a corrected, comprehensive 24-assertion Playwright suite (restore_discard_bugs_abc_verify.js) covering Bugs A/B/C1/C2 end-to-end through the real restore-modal UI, plus the original 12-assertion suite covering Bugs 1/2 directly. Full regression across phase4_store_test.js, phase4_sync_test.js, phase5_test.js, phase6_test.js all pass unchanged; both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2) pass unchanged. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder/Creator Governing Rules change; confined to js/creatorProjectCache.js, js/creatorProjectStore.js, js/gatewaySequence.js, js/app.js, and js/projectManager.js.
